# Phase Three — Final Studio Architecture

The Awtsmoos is one while shell, drawer, control, timeline, action, and project appear apart;
Awtsmoos.com reveals each as a smaller Sefirah-like vessel so expansion grows from order instead of accumulating wart.

## CSS architecture

- `styles/studio.css` -> import manifest only.
- `styles/studio/shell.css` -> modal/top/bottom/preview/resizer.
- `styles/studio/properties.css` -> drawer/tabs/property groups.
- `styles/studio/controls.css` -> fields/buttons/ranges/colors/checks/selects/textarea.
- `styles/studio/timeline.css` -> toolbar/header/tracks/labels/lane/playhead.
- `styles/studio/clips.css` -> blocks/selection/trim handles/types.
- `styles/studio/layers.css` -> named Studio z-index tokens and state layering.
- `styles/studio/responsive.css` -> phone/short-height drawer/timeline geometry.
- `styles/studio/interaction.css` -> hover/active/focus-visible/disabled/reduced-motion.

## JS property architecture

- `ui/PropertiesPanelController.js` -> tabs/drawer/content coordinator.
- `ui/StudioResizerController.js` -> pointer-based bounded split resizing.
- `ui/props/StudioFieldFactory.js` -> labels/selects/ranges/colors/numbers/textarea/check rows.
- `ui/props/StudioActionFactory.js` -> semantic buttons/action rows.
- Rewrite `global.js`, `clip.js`, `fx.js` as safe DOM renderers using factories.
- `ui.js` becomes a small compatibility gateway exporting timeline/binds/properties/resizer.

## Oversized live module architecture after property/CSS wave

- Split `actions.js` into small feature modules while keeping the aggregator export surface.
- Split `interaction.js` into drag session, snap engine, and timeline selection controller.
- Split `project.js` into DB repository, state codec, and project gateway.

## Layer law

Use Rebbe tokens plus Studio-local aliases; no raw 9999 or arbitrary 200/100 values in the rewritten Studio CSS.

## Verification graph

code-first full-file rewrites -> line ceiling -> syntax -> no property `innerHTML`/inline event attributes -> static CSS imports -> named layer scan -> control interaction scan -> full Rebbe tests -> new Studio tests -> fresh HTTP route -> browser proof if adapter cooperates -> post-implementation delta -> next sitewide node.
